LanguageData.RHAH_RecordBox.label: old box
LanguageData.RHAH_RecordBox.description: An old wooden box with a lid that still closes. It holds hauling lists, ration records, and a stack of damp papers.
LanguageData.RHAH_MigrationRecord.label: haul record
LanguageData.RHAH_MigrationRecord.description: A few pages of lists stuck together. The quantities were corrected twice, and the last correction was left unsigned.
